newsitem.headline: EP FOREIGN AFFAIRS COMMITTEE AGENDA - DEC 16.

text.p: Committee on Foreign Affairs, Security and Defence Policy

1. Adoption of draft agenda (PE 220.600 ) 2. Approval of minutes of meetings of: - 26 November 1996, in Brussels (PE 220.599 ) 3. Chairman's announcements 4. Meeting of the North Atlantic Council (Brussels - 10/11 December 1996). - Exchange of views with Mr John BARRETT, from the International Secretariat of the Atlantic Alliance. 5. OSCE Summit (Lisbon - 2/3 December 1996). - Exchange of views with representatives from the Council and the Commission. 6. Part-session of the North Atlantic Assembly (Paris - 17/21 November 1996). - Exchange of views with the ad hoc delegation (PE 220.598 ) 7. Part-session of the WEU Assembly (Paris - 2/5 December 1996). - Exchange of views with the ad hoc Delegation 8. Any other business 9. Date of next meeting (PE/I/OJ/97-01/SCA )
[FOOTNOTES]1. ) Public meeting unless decided otherwise. - FIN - END OF DOCUMENT.
